signature: SUBROUTINE DLAGV2( A, LDA, B, LDB, ALPHAR, ALPHAI, BETA, CSL, SNL,

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the 2 x 2 matrix A. On exit, A is overwritten by the \`\`A-part'' of the generalized Schur form.

params.name: lda
params.reference: THe leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge 2$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the upper triangular 2 x 2 matrix B. On exit, B is overwritten by the \`\`B-part'' of the generalized Schur form.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: THe leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge 2$.

params.name: BETA
params.reference: (`ALPHAR(k)`+i\*`ALPHAI(k)`)/`BETA(k)` are the eigenvalues of the pencil (A,B), $k=1$,2, $i = \sqrt{-1}$. Note that `BETA(k)` may be zero.

params.name: csl
params.reference: The cosine of the left rotation matrix.

params.name: snl
params.reference: The sine of the left rotation matrix.

params.name: csr
params.reference: The cosine of the right rotation matrix.

params.name: snr
params.reference: The sine of the right rotation matrix.
